name: Drop Stacker
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: suwizx_
description: Fabric mod for Minecraft that automatically merges dropped item entities on the ground into stacked entities — reducing item lag on servers and singleplayer worlds. Configurable stack size, scan radius, and scan interval.
needs: Mixin: 3 points inside the game's methods
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
